queue.defaultTicker: Please keep your token ready. Thank you for your patience.
queue.soundHint: Tap anywhere to turn on announcements

board.title: Queue board
board.subtitle: Every queue at a glance — who is waiting, who is being seen. Updates every few seconds.
board.walkInHint: Patients with an appointment get their token when you check them in on the Appointments screen. Use this for walk-ins and counters.
board.cancelConfirmMessage: {{name}} will be removed from the queue.

displays.title: TV displays
displays.subtitle: Screens in waiting areas that show who is being called — with a chime and voice.
displays.queuesHint: Up to 8 fit comfortably on a TV
displays.messagePlaceholder: Shown along the bottom of the screen
displays.note: On the TV’s browser: sign in once with a front-desk account, open the display and press F11 for full screen. Tap the screen once so the browser allows the voice announcements.

counter.title: My counter
counter.subtitle: Call patients one by one. The TV display announces each call.
counter.keys: Keys: N call next · R recall · D done · S not here
counter.note: Put a TV in the waiting area: Queue › Displays › Open on TV. Calls show there with a chime and voice.

queues.title: Queue setup
queues.subtitle: Doctor queues are created with each doctor. Add counters for billing, sample collection and pharmacy.
queues.doctorNote: Doctor queues follow the doctor (name, room, on/off). Only the token prefix can change here.
queues.prefixHint: 1–3 letters, e.g. BL → tokens BL-001, BL-002…
